purpose: Fresh compile-only proof of runtime-discovered per-item capability fanout.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/goal_compiler.py')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gc',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
reg=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json').read_text())['capabilities']
goal=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/missions/ASTRA_RUNTIME_LIVE_DYNAMIC_FANOUT_001.json').read_text())['goal']
out=m.compile_goal(goal,reg,pathlib.Path('.').resolve())
assert out.get('compiler_mode')=='DETERMINISTIC_DYNAMIC_FANOUT_PLAN', out
acts=out.get('controller_actions') or []
assert [a.get('type') for a in acts]==['invoke_capability','invoke_capability_fanout','assert_runtime_fanout_decodes','finish'], acts
print('DYNAMIC_FANOUT_COMPILER_V2_COMPLETE')
PY
